summary: Protests in Iran escalated with public executions and IRGC deployment amid US threats to Iranian vessels. Israeli forces conducted airstrikes in Gaza and intercepted drones near Jordan. Kurdish opposition targets in Iraq faced explosions and drone attacks. (Source: @shin_persian/8573, @presstv/200570, @idf_telegram/24735, @naya_foriraq/85845)
key_points: Public executions in Isfahan, Iran, prompted IRGC armed units and rooftop snipers to suppress crowds, with reports of a woman shot dead. (Source: @shin_persian/8573)
US threatened Iranian commercial vessels and oil tankers in territorial waters over three days, escalating regional tensions. (Source: @presstv/200570)
Houthis claimed responsibility for damaging gas storage tanks at Saudi Arabia's Abqaiq refinery, with imagery showing cooling operations. (Source: @shin_persian/8554)
Israeli airstrikes in Gaza killed Hamas's internal security commander in Deir al-Balah, targeting intelligence operations. (Source: @manniefabian/58868)
Israeli forces intercepted two unmanned aircraft near Jordan border; no breach of Israeli territory occurred. (Source: @inon_yttach/9684)
Kurdish opposition headquarters in Iraq's Sulaymaniyah and Erbil faced explosions and drone attacks, attributed to separatist groups. (Source: @naya_foriraq/85845, @naya_foriraq/85837)
Israeli military destroyed a Hamas tunnel network in northern Gaza, spanning hundreds of meters underground. (Source: @inon_yttach/9693)
Palestinian worker return to settlements in Judea and Samaria approved under security protocols. (Source: @New_security8200/203019)

sections.threat_assessment: Iran faces internal unrest with public executions and IRGC suppression, raising risks of broader instability. US-Iran tensions escalate with maritime threats, potentially disrupting Gulf shipping. Houthi attacks on Saudi oil infrastructure signal proxy conflict escalation. Israeli strikes in Gaza and drone intercepts highlight ongoing security operations. Kurdish opposition targets in Iraq suggest cross-border militant activity. (Source: @shin_persian/8573, @presstv/200570, @shin_persian/8554, @manniefabian/58868, @naya_foriraq/85845)
sections.regional_response: US-Iran tensions intensify with threats to commercial vessels, risking broader Gulf disruptions. Saudi Arabia responds to Houthi attacks with defensive measures and diplomatic condemnation. Israeli military operations in Gaza and Jordan border intercepts reflect sustained security posture. Lebanese authorities conduct arrests amid ongoing unrest. Regional actors brace for potential escalation. (Source: @presstv/200570, @VahidOnline/77541, @inon_yttach/9684, @rasedal3ado138e/381394)
sections.intelligence_notes: UN experts urge Iran to halt executions amid public unrest, signaling international concern. Satellite imagery claims by Zelensky suggest Iran-Russia coordination, though unverified. Economic impacts emerge as oil prices drop amid US-Iran tensions. Proxy conflicts in Yemen and Iraq indicate regional proxy warfare. Intelligence gaps persist in verifying cross-border militant activities. (Source: @mamlekate/104012, @Faytuks_Network/5793, @VahidOnline/77530)
